name: Serpent Ring
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot: ring; Price: 10,000 gp; Weight: —

DESCRIPTION

These gold rings are fashioned to resemble a snake devouring its own tail and endow the wearer with some of the aspects of a serpent. The wearer gains a +3 competence bonus to Stealth and Escape Artist checks. The ring also gives the wearer the Scent ability three times per week for one hour, activated as a supernatural ability. As long as the ring is worn, the wearer’s tongue becomes forked and his voice takes on a hissing quality. As a result, he suffers a – 2 penalty to Charisma-based skill checks in social situations where he must speak.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells cat’s grace, invisibility, serpent strike*; Cost: 5,000 gp
